# Hostingpine

Hostingpine sets up web hosting for you and sells it as a prepaid 12-month plan: shared, WordPress, VPS and cloud hosting. One-time payments in USD through Stripe, no automatic renewal. After payment the customer sends a domain name and we email the access details. Domain names are not included and no uptime guarantee is published.
